questions.question: How does the user of Maculation activate the technique?
questions.subject: Maculation

answer.item: The user crouches down and activates Simple Domain, which briefly manifests as several interconnected domains around them.

questions.question: What does the attack interception program in Maculation do?
questions.subject: Maculation

answer.item: This Simple Domain incorporates a fully automatic attack interception program that enables the user to automatically block or evade any attacks made against them by intruders in the domain while simultaneously counterattacking. This technique is highly effective when facing multiple opponents.
